cohort: A total of 416 hospitalized antenatal and postpartum patients aged 18 years and older from the Korle Bu Teaching Hospital in Ghana were included.
finding: Hospitalized obstetric patients with an increased duration of hospital stay, emergency cesarean delivery, and concomitant positive screen for depression or pregnancy distress were more likely to have poor sleep quality.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery was associated with a higher likelihood of poor sleep quality among postpartum participants.
